_doc: Full-study model registry. role: primary = all conditions; control = condition A only. gpu: preferred Slurm gres (alternatives in gpu_alt, all verified to hold weights + KV at max_model_len). n_agents: concurrent agents per vLLM server, provisional until staging gate S4 (KV p95 < 90%, no preemption, agent time within 1.25x of pilot at 8). guard_s: stop claiming new attempts this many seconds before the job ends (about pilot p99 attempt time + grading). Sampling is identical for every model (pilot P3.2): T=0.7, top_p=0.8, max_tokens=4096, 50 steps, 32k context.

swe-agent-lm-32b.note: KV-bound at 8 agents on one 96 GB card (pilot KV usage 100%); does not start on one 80 GB H100 at 32k (pilot jobs 1570488-90)

qwen2.5-coder-32b.note: same architecture as SWE-agent-LM-32B (its base family); not run in the pilot: inclusion gate S5 in staging

qwen2.5-coder-7b.note: pre-registered degenerate-agent control (pilot P3); revision = HF refs/main at download

gpt-oss-120b.note: replaces Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct (gated, manual approval; no HF token on this account: results/full_prep/model_access.json). Native MXFP4 MoE (117B total, 5.1B active). Reasoning effort = model default (medium); hidden reasoning is not part of the trajectory. Inclusion gate S5 in staging
